curatorNote: Verified batch of 12 Starbucks USA food products spanning breakfast sandwiches, a breakfast wrap, lunch sandwiches, egg bites, and bakery. All entries use first-party Starbucks nutrition pages and standard consumer servings; store availability and nutrition may vary by location or customization.

qualityReview.note: Verified 10 food-only items against direct Starbucks U.S. nutrition pages, including serving mass and calories, carbohydrates, protein, and fat. Fiber and sodium were retained where listed; unreported optional nutrients remain null. Beverages were excluded.

appendHistory.curatorNote: Coverage includes 6 current Starbucks USA products from the official Treats category: four cake pops, one blondie, one cookie, and one brownie. Two listed Treats were omitted because complete first-party nutrition facts were not available in the retrieved source. ([starbucks.com](https://www.starbucks.com/menu/food/treats?utm_source=openai))
appendHistory.verifierNote: Verified all six proposed food items against direct first-party Starbucks U.S. nutrition pages. Calories, carbohydrates, protein, fat, serving size, fiber, and sodium shown above are supported; optional micronutrients not displayed by those pages remain null.
